tasks.short: Design cognitive aids such as storyboards and decision support.

steps.what: Gather the decisions these support systems must cover.

loop.output: Decision list: the choice, the cue and what a wrong choice does
loop.check: Engineer drops a decision the task does not contain
loop.stop: One pass; a step with no decision is left out
loop.why_not_simpler: Tasks describe choices in prose, not as a fixed aid

steps.what: Design procedural storyboards for the cognitive aid.

loop.output: Storyboard frames in task order, each with the decision and the cue
loop.check: Engineer cuts a frame that adds a step the task does not have
loop.stop: One draft; a decision with no frame stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: The order is this task's order, not a generic script

steps.what: Check the storyboard with a person doing the task.
Judge failure modes of the cognitive aid.

tasks.design: Decisions can be listed from the task in {DOCS}, and procedural storyboards drafted in task order. The engineer still checks the cognitive aid with a person who does the work, and judges the failure modes. The decision support storyboard is issued only after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Storyboards were drawn from the procedure text and tried after they were issued.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can follow the decision list. The check with the person stays.
tasks.still_hard: A clear frame that hides the cue the person actually uses.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer saw the person use the aid and will not issue a frame that misleads.

ambition.what: Revise the storyboard when the task changes, not only at first design.

tasks.altitude: The check stays. The engineer can withhold an issue the person showed was wrong.

reach.task: State which decision the aid must not hide
reach.learn: Which hardware state the storyboard has to show and which it may omit

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a task description to an issued storyboard. Building the software aid is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} storyboard template before custom code.
Structured fields are decision, cue, frame and failure mode. The task description produces the decision. Fallback: a cue found only in the check is typed and marked as seen.
The check is not a performance score.
unknowns: Whether the person can try the aid on the real task.
Who will maintain the storyboard after issue.
research_questions: Which failure modes need a second check before issue?

already_counted.description: Judging failure modes the draft cannot see
Checking the issued frames against the judgement

incremental.description: Keep frame order aligned with the task

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A stable task saves the decision list and the first storyboard. The check and the failure judgement stay. The low case is a task that has not been watched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze complex systems for development potential, including aviation.

steps.what: Map interfaces of the complex systems.

loop.output: Map of interfaces, what crosses each one, and who acts
loop.check: Engineer removes an interface the description does not name
loop.stop: One pass; an unnamed link stays as a question
loop.why_not_simpler: Descriptions are prose and drawings, not one interface list

steps.what: Score interoperability, compatibility and production gaps.
Aerospace engineer states the aviation constraint.

loop.output: Analysis of development potential, with the gap it rests on
loop.check: Engineer deletes a conclusion the judgement did not reach
loop.stop: One draft; a gap with no conclusion stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: The analysis has to follow this system, not a generic aviation note

tasks.design: Interfaces of the complex systems can be mapped in {DOCS}, and interoperability and compatibility gaps scored in {SPREADSHEET}. Judging development potential and usefulness stays with the engineer, including the aviation constraint from the aerospace engineer. The analysis is filed only for conclusions the judgement reached.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interface lists were redrawn for each question, and usefulness was a paragraph with no gap behind it.
tasks.enabler_now: The map and the scores can be ready. The judgement stays.
tasks.still_hard: A gap score that is real and a development claim the aviation constraint forbids.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not file a usefulness claim the constraint rules out.
tasks.altitude: The judgement stays. The engineer can refuse an analysis line the constraint contradicted.

reach.task: State the aviation limit on further development
reach.learn: Which gaps are airworthiness issues and which are only awkward for the crew

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A drafted number is usable only when it traces to a record the engineer accepts.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a system description to a filed analysis. Certifying the aircraft is out of scope.
Test {SPREADSHEET} gap scores before custom code.
Structured fields are interface, gap, score and conclusion. The description produces the interface name. Fallback: a link found only in discussion is typed and marked as said.
The analysis is not a certificate.
unknowns: Whether an aerospace engineer is in the review.
How much of the system description is current.
research_questions: Which gaps need a crew trial before a development claim?

already_counted.description: Judging potential the scores cannot rank
Cutting conclusions the judgement did not reach

incremental.description: Keep interface names aligned with the system description

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A described system saves the map and the scores. The judgement and the aviation constraint stay. The low case is a system with no current description.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate theoretical human design issues for landers and habitats.

steps.what: Investigate prior studies on the question.

loop.output: Notes with the claim and the study it came from
loop.check: Engineer drops a claim the study did not make
loop.stop: One pass; a study with no usable claim is left out
loop.why_not_simpler: The studies do not share one template

steps.what: Frame the theoretical and conceptual issues.
Sketch human design considerations for lunar landers and habitats.
Discuss the issues with peer engineers.
Write the note on those considerations.

loop.output: Note that separates a consideration from a claim of fact
loop.check: Engineer deletes a fact the discussion did not accept
loop.stop: One draft; an open issue stays marked open
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must not read as a finished habitat design

tasks.design: Prior studies can be extracted into {DOCS} with the claim and the source. Framing the theoretical issues, and sketching human design considerations for lunar landers and habitats, stay with the engineer. The note is written after discussion with peers and does not pretend the sketches are a buildable design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each question began with a fresh stack of papers and the note mixed ideas with findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Source notes can be prepared. The framing and the sketches stay.
tasks.still_hard: A consideration that sounds like a measured result.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not write a habitat note that claims a result the studies did not have.
tasks.altitude: The thinking stays. The engineer can mark an issue open rather than resolve it on paper.

reach.task: Name the habitat constraint the note must respect
reach.learn: Which considerations the vehicle already rules out

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
A drafted number is usable only when it traces to a record the engineer accepts.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a question to a research note. Designing flight hardware is out of scope.
Structured fields are issue, source, consideration and open or not. The studies produce the source. Fallback: a point raised only in discussion is typed and marked as said.
The note is not a design release.
unknowns: Which studies the question is allowed to rely on.
Whether peers are available before the note.
research_questions: Which issues need a study rather than a conceptual note?

already_counted.description: Framing issues the sources do not settle
Separating considerations from claims of fact

incremental.description: Keep source references attached to each issue

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A question with known studies saves the extract. Framing, sketching and the discussion stay. The low case is a question with almost no prior studies.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Operate heat, light, motion and climate testing equipment.

steps.what: Set up octave analyzers and colorimetric detection tubes.
Operate testing equipment, stress meters and inclinometers.
Operate motion analysis equipment and thermoanemometers.
Log sling psychrometers and light meter readings.

tasks.design: The engineer still sets up and operates the testing equipment in the room: octave analyzers, detection tubes, stress meters, inclinometers, motion analysis equipment, thermoanemometers, sling psychrometers and light meters. {SPREADSHEET} only holds the readings after they are taken. A reading that did not come from the instrument is not logged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were copied off instruments at the end of the day into whatever sheet was open.
tasks.enabler_now: The log can be filled from values the engineer enters. Taking the readings stays.
tasks.still_hard: A copied number from the wrong scale or the wrong location.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer ran the instrument and knows which reading to discard.
tasks.altitude: Operating the equipment stays almost the whole task. The engineer can refuse a log line that was not read from the instrument.

reach.task: Calibrate the meter before the session
reach.learn: Which instrument is in calibration and which must not be used

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
These readings are taken on the instrument in the room; a sheet does not operate it.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a test plan to a reading log. Interpreting the study is out of scope.
Test a {SPREADSHEET} log before custom code.
Structured fields are instrument, location, time and value. The engineer produces the value. Fallback: a value that did not transfer is typed and marked manual.
No reading is logged without the instrument that produced it.
unknowns: Which instruments are on site and in calibration.
Whether the location allows the tubes and meters to be used.
research_questions: Which sessions need a second instrument rather than a single meter?

already_counted.description: Checking the log against the instruments just used

incremental.description: Keep instrument names and units from drifting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Almost all of this task is setup and operation. Only the log is shorter. The low case is a site where the instruments cannot be placed as planned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Storyboards can be redrafted. System analysis still needs a judgement. Instrument work barely changes.
reach: Aerospace engineers on aviation constraints and habitats
Computer hardware engineers on what a decision aid must not hide
skills_to_grow: Checking a storyboard with the person who does the task
Not treating a conceptual note as a finished design
Trusting the instrument in the room over a copied reading
role.ambitious_version: A storyboard is revised when the task changes, and a meter reading is still taken by the engineer.
